market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI settled $102.27 on May 5, currently ~$100; $115 requires +15% rally by end of June (~8 weeks). Iran ceasefire + potential sanctions relief is bearish near-term. However, if talks collapse and bombing resumes, $115 plausible. Two-sided risk; base rate of 15% rally in 2 months ~25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran-US negotiation outcome dominates near-term oil path.
